explain.title: Make the greeting warmer
explain.body: The first section demonstrates a one-line modification.

sections.diff:
diff --git a/src/greeting.ts b/src/greeting.ts
--- a/src/greeting.ts
+++ b/src/greeting.ts
@@ -1,3 +1,3 @@
 export function greeting(name: string) {
-  return `Hello, ${name}.`
+  return `Welcome, ${name}!`
 }

explain.title: Add a farewell
explain.body: The second section makes navigation and per-section folding easy to verify.

sections.diff:
diff --git a/src/farewell.ts b/src/farewell.ts
new file mode 100644
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/farewell.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,3 @@
+export function farewell(name: string) {
+  return `See you soon, ${name}!`
+}
